text:
maria-l: Heads up — GO-FIX is generating a token/session surge hitting Dedicated. Want to do a short canary cut: disable creation of new sessions for that customer for 15 minutes (auto-reenable). Need quick async approvals and confirm exact command + audit path.

alex_w: Quick clarifying Q — this is new-session creation only, not full traffic failover, right?

maria-l: Correct, only new sessions. We have a per-customer flag `route.allow_new_sessions` keyed by subject=customer:GO-FIX. Plan: set to `false` with TTL=900s. Runbook ref RINF-STOP-7.

jordan_sre: Approvals policy: prefer two approvers from ops-emergency or oncall groups. Also confirm flag-change events land in audit-kinesis and show up in console. Who will run the command?

kai_ops: Guardrail: only members of group=ops-emergency have permission to mutate route flags. CLI we use (platform):
```sh
rctl flag set --name route.allow_new_sessions \
  --subject customer:GO-FIX \
  --value false \
  --meta reason=token-storm,initiator=slack \
  --ttl 900
```
This emits `audit:event:flag-change` to audit-kinesis and writes a `flag_change` line to infra-logs with meta.

maria-l: I'll run once we have two approvals here and PR for audit retention is green (PR #519 increases infra-logs retention 30d->90d). @alex_w can you review? If not merged, we'll snapshot logs to S3.

alex_w: I can review PR #519 in ~30m. If urgent, proceed but capture stdout and snapshot logs manually.

sam: Ops notes: rollback if needed is `rctl flag delete --name route.allow_new_sessions --subject customer:GO-FIX`. Open an INC and paste CLI output and the audit event id. Console watch rule: `audit:event:flag-change` where subject=customer:GO-FIX.

jordan_sre: Also record approvers in the INC and the runbook id. We'll need the audit-event id to grep kinesis.

maria-l: Posting approvals — @alex_w @jordan_sre please approve so I can execute. @oncall-bot create temp incident and attach this thread.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-154. Owner: maria-l. Audit-attachment enabled (will retain 90d if PR merges).

alex_w: approved :thumbsup:

jordan_sre: approved, proceed.

maria-l: Executing now. CLI output:
```sh
$ rctl flag set --name route.allow_new_sessions --subject customer:GO-FIX --value false --meta reason=token-storm,initiator=maria-l --ttl 900
OK  fl_9902  emit=audit:event:flag-change id=ae_20260421_99
```
Console shows immediate drop in new session creation within ~30s. INC-2026-154 updated with audit id ae_20260421_99 and CLI stdout.

sam: I'll bind a log alert to INC-2026-154 and watch for 5xx spikes or client errors; if we see 5xxs escalate to infra pager.

maria-l: Note — TTL auto-reenable in 15m. If we decide to keep it off, we'll schedule a short maintenance window and coordinate with GO-FIX. Will post follow-up when TTL expires or if we extend. Thanks all.
